1.title: Grammar Auction: classroom English
1.stage: CORE 20 iboralaridan keyin, 'Mashqlar' bosqichida (15 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi, qolgani takrorga.
1.goal: Sinf iboralarining (May I…?, Can you…?, What does … mean?, Listen to me, You're welcome) to'g'ri va xato shaklini ajratish va xatoni tuzatish.
rules: Sinfni 3–4 jamoaga bo'ling. Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz iborani doskaga yozadi yoki o'qiydi (masalan: 'Listen me, please.'). Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: ibora to'g'rimi yoki xato?
Jamoalar iborani 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa iborani oladi.
Ibora TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato iborani birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri aytgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: 'Listen TO me, please.'). Ustoz iboraning o'zbekcha tarjimasini ham so'raydi.
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI ibora sotib olgan jamoa g'olib; teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa.

1.title: Board Game: classroom phrases
1.stage: 2-dars boshida takror yoki 1-darsda 'Mashqlar' o'rniga (20 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi, qolgani takrorga.
1.goal: CORE va STRONG sinf iboralarini og'zaki ishlatish: o'zbekchadan inglizchaga aytish, xato iborani tuzatish, savol berish va javob qaytarish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi. Javob varag'i guruh sardorida turadi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: iborani inglizcha aytadi, tuzatadi yoki javob beradi.
Sardor javob varag'idan tekshiradi. Xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi; to'g'ri javobni hamma bir marta takrorlaydi.
'Say in English' kataklarida iborani to'liq aytish shart (masalan: 'Look at the board.', faqat 'board' emas).
Pushti kataklardagi buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan g'olib.

1.title: Dominoes: classroom questions and answers
1.stage: CORE 20 iboralari o'qilib, jo'r takrorlangandan keyin, juftlikda (10 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi, qolgani takrorga.
1.goal: Sinfdagi savol va iltimoslarga mos javobni topish: How are you? → I'm fine, thank you; May I come in? → Yes, come in; Thank you → You're welcome.
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshini bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi savol yoki iboraga mos javobni boshqa toshning chap tomonidan toping (masalan: 'How are you?' → 'I'm fine, thank you. And you?').
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; zanjir FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.
Tugatgan guruh zanjirni dialog qilib o'qiydi: bir o'quvchi savolni, ikkinchisi javobni aytadi.
Ustoz tekshiradi; xato bo'lsa guruh tuzatadi. Birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tugatgan guruh g'olib.

Never mind. Look at your partner's book.

1.title: Taboo: classroom words and commands
1.stage: 'Sinf qoidalari va Telegram' bosqichidan oldin, harakatli dam olish (10 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi, qolgani takrorga.
1.goal: Sinfdagi narsalar (board, notebook, dictionary) va buyruqlarni (Raise your hand, Be quiet) oddiy inglizcha so'z va imo-ishora bilan tushuntirish.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga tushuntiradi: oddiy inglizcha so'zlar va imo-ishora (mime) mumkin; kartadagi so'z va 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Narsani barmoq bilan ko'rsatish va o'zbekcha gapirish mumkin emas — birinchi darsdanoq inglizcha o'ylashni boshlaymiz.
Jamoa topsa +1 ball, keyingi kartaga o'tiladi. Taqiqlangan yoki o'zbekcha so'z aytilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi.
Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

1.title: Find someone who can…: learning English
1.stage: 'Qanday o'rganamiz' bosqichidan keyin, harakatli mashq (10 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi, qolgani takrorga.
1.goal: 'Can you …?' tayyor savol boshi bilan (darsdagi 'Can you repeat, please?' kabi) ingliz tilini o'rganish haqida so'rash va qisqa javob berish: Yes, I can. / No, I can't.
rules: Doskaga savol boshini yozing: 'Can you …?'. Javoblar: 'Yes, I can.' / 'No, I can't.' Hamma jo'r bo'lib 2 marta takrorlaydi. Varaqdagi 'his/her' savolda 'your' bo'ladi.
Har o'quvchiga varaq bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi va sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zi tuzib so'raydi (masalan: Can you spell your name in English?).
Suhbat faqat inglizcha: 'Hello!' bilan boshlanadi, 'Thank you!' bilan tugaydi.
'Yes, I can' degan sinfdosh buni darrov ko'rsatib beradi (masalan, alifboni aytadi), keyin uning ismi yoziladi. Bitta odamning ismi faqat 1 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va 2–3 natijani aytadi (masalan: 'Aziz can spell his name in English.').

1.title: Speaking cards: what do you say in class?
1.stage: 'Mashqlar' bosqichida, mini-dialog mashqi o'rniga (12 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi, qolgani takrorga.
1.goal: Vaziyatga mos sinf iborasini topib aytish (May I come in?, I don't understand, Can you repeat, please?, How do you spell it?) va 2 qatorli mini-dialog qurish.
rules: Juftliklarga kartalar to'plamini bering; kartalar teskari dasta qilib qo'yiladi.
Birinchi o'quvchi kartani oladi, vaziyatni o'qiydi va kerakli iborani inglizcha aytadi (masalan: 'Sorry I'm late. May I come in?').
Sherigi ustoz yoki sinfdosh rolida javob qaytaradi (masalan: 'Yes, come in, please.') — shunday 2 qatorli mini-dialog chiqadi.
To'g'ri ibora — +1 ball; 'please' yoki 'thank you' o'z o'rnida qo'shilsa — yana +1 ball.
Rollar almashadi. 12 daqiqadan keyin eng ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib; 2–3 juftlik eng yaxshi dialogini sinfga ko'rsatadi.

2.title: Grammar Auction: am / is / are + adjective
2.stage: Yangi mavzu (formula) tushuntirilgandan keyin, sinf mashqlaridan oldin (15 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi, qolgani takrorga.
2.goal: To be + sifat gaplarida to'g'ri va xatoni ajratish: egaga mos am/is/are, inkorda not, savolda to be oldinda, sifat oldida a/an yo'q.
rules: Sinfni 3–4 jamoaga bo'ling. Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni doskaga yozadi yoki o'qiydi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi yoki xato? Egaga qarang: I → am, he/she/it → is, you/we/they → are.
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: 'I am a hungry' → 'I am hungry').
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib; teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa.

2.title: Dominoes: Are you hungry? — No, I'm not.
2.stage: Kombinatsiya warm-up va normativdan keyin, juftlikda (12 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi, qolgani takrorga.
2.goal: To be savollariga qisqa javob: egani olmosh bilan almashtirish (your mother → she, your parents → they) va Yes, … is / No, … isn't ni ma'noga qarab tanlash.
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshini bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi savolga mos javobni boshqa toshning chap tomonidan toping.
Ikki narsani tekshiring: 1) olmosh egaga mosmi (your father → he, the tea → it, you and Ali → we); 2) ma'no to'g'rimi (hungry? → No, I'm not. I'm full).
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulang; zanjir FINISH bilan tugashi kerak. Tugatgan guruh zanjirni savol-javob qilib ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi.
Ustoz tekshiradi; xato ulangan bo'lsa guruh tuzatadi. Birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tugatgan guruh g'olib.

2.title: Taboo: common adjectives
2.stage: CORE 20 sifat o'qilib, gap tuzilgandan keyin (10 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi, qolgani takrorga.
2.goal: CORE va STRONG sifatlarni (hungry, thirsty, rich, lazy, famous…) inglizcha tushuntirish; tushuntirishda 'You are … when …', 'He is …' kabi to be gaplarini ishlatish.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida sifatni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi: kartadagi so'z va 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi. Namuna (cold): 'Tashkent is … in January.'
Imo-ishora mumkin, lekin o'zbekcha gapirish mumkin emas.
Jamoa topsa +1 ball; topgan o'quvchi shu so'z bilan to be gapi aytsa (masalan: 'Messi is famous.') — yana +1 ball.
Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi. Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

2.title: Find someone who… is nervous before tests
2.stage: 'Mashq 5 — Find someone who…' bosqichida, darslikdagi jadval o'rniga (10 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi, qolgani takrorga.
2.goal: 'Are you + sifat?' savolini o'zi tuzish, 'Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.' deb javob berish va natijani 'is / isn't' bilan aytish.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Doskaga namuna yozing: 'Are you …?' — 'Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.'
Hamma o'rnidan turadi va sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zi tuzib so'raydi (masalan: Are you nervous before tests?).
'Yes, I am' degan sinfdoshning ismini yozadi. Iloji boricha har qatorga boshqa odam; bitta ism ko'pi bilan 2 marta yoziladi.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi.
Oxirida 3–4 o'quvchi natijani 'is / isn't' bilan aytadi: 'Dilnoza is nervous before tests. Aziz isn't lazy in the morning.'

3.title: Taboo: Common adjectives 2
3.goal: Adjectives 2 sifatlarini (delicious, noisy, polite, dangerous …) oddiy inglizcha gaplar bilan tushuntirish: 'It is not …', 'The opposite is …', 'Ice cream is …'.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi (kartani jamoasiga ko'rsatmaydi).
60 soniya ichida sifatni jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi; so'zning o'zi va kartadagi 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Yordamchi gaplar: 'It is not …', 'The opposite is …', 'Ice cream is …', 'Our classroom is …'. O'zbekcha gapirish mumkin emas.
Jamoa topsa — +1 ball, o'quvchi keyingi kartaga o'tadi. Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi.
Har navbatda boshqa o'quvchi chiqadi. Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

4.goal: Kasb nomlarini (Jobs CORE va STRONG) inglizcha tushuntirish: 'This person …', 'He/She is a … person', 'He works in a …'.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi (jamoasiga ko'rsatmaydi).
60 soniya ichida kasbni jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi; kasb nomi va kartadagi 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Yordamchi gaplar: 'This person works in a …', 'He/She is a kind/strong person', 'My uncle is a …'. Imo-ishora mumkin, o'zbekcha — yo'q.
Jamoa topsa va javobni a/an bilan aytsa ('a nurse!', 'an actor!') — +1 ball. Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqibga o'tadi.
Har navbatda boshqa o'quvchi chiqadi. Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

4.title: Find someone who… is a good singer
4.stage: Kombinatsiya bosqichidan keyin — dars o'rtasida harakatli mashq (10 daqiqa)
4.goal: Are you a + sifat + ot? / Is your … a + sifat + ot? / Are your … + sifat + ot-s? savollarini tuzish va qisqa javob berish.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni O'ZLARI tuzadi: 'Are you a good singer?', 'Is your mother a great cook?', 'Are your friends good gamers?'.
Javob: 'Yes, I am / No, I'm not', 'Yes, she is / No, he isn't', 'Yes, they are'. 'Yes' degan o'quvchining ismi yoziladi.
Bitta o'quvchining ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yoziladi. Savolda a/an yoki sifat o'rni xato bo'lsa — ism hisoblanmaydi.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va natijani to'liq gap bilan aytadi: 'Jasur is a fast runner.'

START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng yarmidagi gap boshiga (masalan: 'The plane is at') mos davomni boshqa toshning chap yarmidan toping.

START toshini qo'ying. Toshning o'ng yarmida SAVOL bor — unga mos JAVOBni boshqa toshning chap yarmidan toping.
Javob savolga to'liq mos bo'lsin: ega (I/he/she/it/we/they) va am/is/are savoldagiga to'g'ri kelishi kerak (Are these…? — Yes, they are.).
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; zanjir FINISH bilan tugaydi.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh savol-javoblarni juftlikda ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi; ustoz tekshiradi. Xato bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi; to'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.

Jamoa topsa +1 ball; topgan o'quvchi shu predlog bilan sinf haqida gap aytsa yana +1 ball (The bag is under the desk.).
Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi. Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

7.title: Grammar Auction: am / is / are + verb-ing
7.stage: Yangi mavzudan keyin, fe'llar (TPR) bosqichidan oldin (15 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlang, qolgani — takrorga.
7.goal: Present continuous (am/is/are + fe'l-ing) gaplarida xatoni topish va tuzatish: to be tushib qolishi, -ing yo'qligi, -ing imlosi (writing, swimming) va savolda so'z tartibi.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.

Ustoz gapni doskaga yozadi yoki o'qiydi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi yoki xato? Tekshirish: am/is/are bormi, fe'lda -ing bormi, -ing to'g'ri yozilganmi, savolda to be egadan oldinmi?
Jamoalar gapni sotib olish uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikkan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: I watching → I am watching).
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib; teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa.

10.title: Grammar Auction: goes, doesn't go, Does she go?

rules: Sinfni 3–4 jamoaga bo'ling. Har jamoaning boshlang'ich puli — 1000 (doskaga yozib qo'ying).

Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: 'He doesn't plays' → 'He doesn't play').
12 gap tugagach, eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib; teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa.

rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying.
Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi karta oladi va 60 soniya ichida fe'lni inglizcha tushuntiradi — fe'lning o'zi va 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Yordamchi gaplar: 'You can do it in summer.', 'A cat can do it.', 'People do it when they are happy.', 'Don't do it in class!' Taqiqlangan so'zlar hech qaysi gapda aytilmaydi.
Harakat bilan ko'rsatish (mime) va o'zbekcha gapirish mumkin emas — faqat inglizcha so'z bilan.

11.title: Find someone who… can swim
11.stage: Dars o'rtasida harakatli mashq — Reading'dan oldin (10 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
11.goal: 'Can you + V1…?' savolini tuzish va 'Yes, I can. / No, I can't.' qisqa javobini berish; harakat fe'llarini ishlatish.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turib sinfda yuradi.
Har qator uchun savolni o'zi tuzadi: 'Can you + V1…?' (masalan: Can you ride a horse?). Javob faqat qisqa: 'Yes, I can. / No, I can't.'
Qatorga mos javob bergan odamning ismini yozadi ('can't' qatorida — 'No, I can't' degan odamning ismi).
Ismni yozishdan oldin xavfsiz qatorlarda 'Show me, please!' deb so'rash mumkin (masalan, bir oyoqda turib ko'rsatadi).
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yoziladi.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va sinfga aytib beradi: 'Aziz can swim. Lola can't ride a bike.'

rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turib sinfda yuradi.

13.title: Grammar Auction: there is / there are, some / any
13.stage: There is/are, some/any tushuntirilgandan keyin, Kombinatsiyadan oldin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
13.goal: There is / there are, there was / there were, some / any va sanalmaydigan otlar (milk, money, news) to'g'ri yoki xato ishlatilganini ajratish va xatoni tuzatish.
rules: Sinfni 3–4 jamoaga bo'ling; har jamoaga auksion varag'i va 1000 'pul' bering.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi va doskaga yozadi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: is/are, was/were, some/any, a/some, How much/How many to'g'ri tanlanganmi?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikkan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: 'a milk' → 'some milk', 'isn't some' → 'isn't any').
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib; teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa.

16.title: Grammar Auction: went, bought, didn't go
16.stage: Yangi mavzu (V2, didn't + V1) tushuntirilgandan keyin, Kombinatsiya o'rniga (15 daqiqa); darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi
16.goal: Past simple noto'g'ri fe'llar bilan: tasdiqda V2 (went, bought, ate, thought), inkor va savolda V1 (didn't go, Did you see?) — xato gapni topish va tuzatish.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000. Doskaga eslatma yozing: (+) ega + V2, (–) didn't + V1, (?) Did + ega + V1.
Ustoz gapni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi va doskaga yozadi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi yoki xato?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: buyed → bought, didn't went → didn't go).
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p qolgan jamoa).

16.title: Dominoes: What did you eat? — I ate…
16.stage: 'Irregular verbs — CORE 20' dan keyin, sinf mashqlaridan oldin (12 daqiqa)
16.goal: Did / What / Where + did + ega + V1? savolini V2 li javob bilan ulash: savoldagi V1 javobda V2 ga aylanadi (eat → ate, buy → bought, leave → left).
rules: Har juftlik yoki guruhga bitta domino to'plamini bering va toshlarni aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi savolga javob bo'ladigan toshni toping: javobda savoldagi fe'lning V2 si turadi (What did you eat? → I ate…).

Birinchi tugatgan guruh butun zanjirni juft bo'lib o'qiydi: biri savolni, ikkinchisi javobni. Ustoz V1 → V2 ni tekshiradi.
Xato ulangan bo'lsa — navbat keyingi guruhga o'tadi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.

Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va 3 ta natijani V2 bilan aytadi: 'Malika saw a good film.'

18.title: Grammar Auction: and, but, so, because, when
18.stage: Yangi mavzu (bog'lovchilar) tushuntirilgandan keyin, sinf mashqlaridan oldin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi
18.goal: Bog'lovchilar to'g'ri yoki xato ishlatilganini ajratish: so (sabab → natija), because (natija ← sabab), and/but, because oldinda — vergul, although + but xatosi, when + past simple.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000. Doskaga eslatma yozing: SABAB, so NATIJA / NATIJA because SABAB.
Ustoz gapni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi va doskaga yozadi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: bog'lovchi to'g'rimi?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikkan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: because → so, but → and, vergul qo'yish).
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).
materials: Doskada eslatma: SABAB, so NATIJA / NATIJA because SABAB

Rollar almashadi. 12 daqiqadan keyin eng ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib; ustoz 2–3 juftlikni sinf oldida tinglaydi.

18.title: Sentence Race: sentences with conjunctions
18.stage: Uyga vazifadan oldin tezkor takror (8 daqiqa) yoki keyingi dars boshida
18.goal: Bog'lovchili murakkab gapda so'z tartibi va vergulni to'g'ri qo'yish (so, because, but, and, when, although, however).
rules: Sinfni 3–4 kishilik jamoalarga bo'ling. Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning aralash so'zlari) bering.
Jamoa so'zlarni stolga to'g'ri tartibda teradi. Yordam: bosh harfli so'z — gap boshi, vergulli so'z — birinchi qism oxiri, nuqtali so'z — gap oxiri.
Tayyor bo'lgach qo'l ko'taradi va gapni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi; ustoz tekshiradi. To'g'ri — +1 ball va konvertlar jamoalar orasida almashtiriladi.
Bonus +1: 'so' li gapni 'because' bilan (yoki aksincha) qayta aytib bersa.
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

rules: Doskaga 4 ustun × 5 qatorli jadval chizing (100–500). Sinfni 3–4 jamoaga bo'ling.

Jamoa 20 soniyada maslahatlashib javob beradi. To'g'ri — ball jamoaga; xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin.

19.title: Grammar Auction: will be / will + V1
19.stage: Yangi mavzu (will be, will + V1) tushuntirilgandan keyin, lug'atdan oldin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi.
19.goal: will be / won't be / Will … be? va will + V1 / won't + V1 / Will …? gaplaridagi xatoni topish: be tushib qolishi, 'wills', 'will to', 'will buys', 'be not', savolda so'z tartibi.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.

Ustoz gapni doskaga yozadi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi yoki xato? Tekshiring: ot/sifat/joy oldida will be bormi, will dan keyin V1 turibdimi ('to' va '-s' yo'q), savolda Will + ega + fe'l tartibi to'g'rimi?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: 'He will goes' → 'He will go').
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

19.title: Dominoes: Will…? questions and answers
19.stage: Kombinatsiya bosqichidan keyin, sinf mashqlaridan oldin (12 daqiqa)
19.goal: will savollarini (Will …? / Where, When, What, Who, How will …?) mos javob bilan ulash; qisqa javoblar: Yes, it will. / No, they won't.
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi savolga qaysi toshning chap tomonidagi javob mos keladi — toping.
Moslikni tekshiring: savol so'zi (Where → joy, When → vaqt, Who → odam, How long → davomiylik) va qisqa javobdagi ega (he, she, they, we, you) savoldagi egaga mos bo'lishi kerak.
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; oxiri FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi (biri savol beradi, biri javob beradi); ustoz tekshiradi.
Xato ulangan bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.

60 soniya ichida fe'lni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.

19.stage: Sinf mashqlari 1–4 dan keyin, Reading'dan oldin harakatli mashq (10 daqiqa)

rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzib so'raydi: 'will be' — Will you be …?, 'will' — Will you + V1 …?, 'going to' — Are you going to …?, 'thinks' — Do you think it will …?

'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va bitta qo'shimcha savol beradi (When will you …? / Where will you …?). 'won't' qatorida 'No, I won't' degan odam yoziladi.
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va natijalarni sinfga aytadi: 'Aziz will be at home tonight.'

20.title: Grammar Auction: If it rains, I will…
20.stage: Yangi mavzu (zero va first conditional) tushuntirilgandan keyin, lug'atdan oldin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi.
20.goal: Zero (If + present, present) va first (If + present, will + V1) conditional gaplardagi xatoni topish: if dan keyin will (if-qism oldinda ham, orqada ham), he da -s tushishi, will + -s, 'don't will', I bilan -s.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.

Ustoz gapni doskaga yozadi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi yoki xato? Tekshiring: if-qismda present simple bormi (will yo'qmi), he/she da -s bormi, natijada will + V1 (zero'da present simple) to'g'rimi?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — pul yo'qoladi.

Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzib so'raydi: odat qatorlarida — Do you … if …?, kelajak qatorlarida — Will you … if …? (if dan keyin will yo'q!).

20.title: Sentence Race: conditional sentences
20.stage: Uyga vazifa berishdan oldin tezkor takror (8 daqiqa) yoki keyingi dars boshida
20.goal: Zero va first conditional gaplarda so'z tartibini tuzish: If + ega + present, … / … will + V1 if …; vergul joyi (if-qism oldinda — vergul, oxirida — vergulsiz).
rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning so'zlari) beriladi.

Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi va qo'lini ko'taradi. Maslahat: katta harfli so'z — gap boshi ('I' har doim katta harf bilan), vergulli so'z — if-qism oxiri, nuqta yoki so'roq belgisi — gap oxiri.
Ustoz tekshiradi: to'g'ri bo'lsa +1 ball va keyingi konvert. Gap turini to'g'ri aytsa yana +1: natijada present simple — zero, will + V1 — first, take/look/don't touch — buyruq gap.
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

21.title: Grammar Auction: I / me, they / them, like / would like
21.stage: Yangi mavzu (olmoshlar + like / would like) tushuntirilgandan keyin, sinf mashqlaridan oldin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi.
21.goal: Ega olmoshlari (I, he, we, they) va to'ldiruvchi olmoshlari (me, him, us, them) hamda like + V-ing / would like + to V to'g'ri ishlatilgan gapni xato gapdan ajratish va xatoni tuzatish.
rules: Sinfni 3–4 jamoaga bo'ling. Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni doskaga yozadi yoki o'qiydi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: olmosh (I/me, he/him, we/us, they/them) va like / would like to'g'ri ishlatilganmi?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: with they → with them, likes swim → likes swimming).
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

22.title: Grammar Auction: my / mine, your / yours, its / it's
22.stage: Yangi mavzu (my / mine, your / yours…) tushuntirilgandan keyin, sinf mashqlaridan oldin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi.
22.goal: Egalik sifati + ot (my book) va otsiz egalik olmoshi (mine, yours, hers, ours, theirs) farqini, its / it's va you / your farqini ajratish; xatoni tuzatish.
rules: Sinfni 3–4 jamoaga bo'ling. Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni doskaga yozadi yoki o'qiydi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: egalik so'zidan keyin ot bormi? Ot bor → my, your, her…; ot yo'q → mine, yours, hers…
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: mine phone → my phone, is her → is hers).
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

22.title: Board Game: Whose is it?
22.stage: Sinf mashqlari 1–5 dan keyin yoki ularning bir qismi o'rniga — og'zaki mustahkamlash (20 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi.
22.goal: Egalik sifati ↔ egalik olmoshi (my ↔ mine, our ↔ ours) almashtirish, xatoni tuzatish, 'Whose…?' savoli va xarakter sifatlari bilan oila va do'stlarni tasvirlash.
rules: Har 3–4 o'quvchiga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni og'zaki bajaradi: shaklni aytadi, gapni tuzatadi yoki to'liq gap tuzadi.
Guruh a'zolari kalit varaqdagi javob bilan tekshiradi ('e.g.' — namuna, boshqa to'g'ri javob ham qabul qilinadi). Xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
'Talk for 20/30 seconds' kataklarida o'yinchi to'xtamay gapiradi va kamida 2 ta egalik so'zi (my, his, her, mine, yours…) va 1 ta xarakter sifati ishlatadi.
Maxsus kataklardagi buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan o'yinchi g'olib.

22.title: Dominoes: Whose is it? + character adjectives
22.stage: Kombinatsiya bosqichidan keyin, sinf mashqlaridan oldin — grammatika mustahkamlash (12 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi.
22.goal: 'Is this …'s …? — Yes, it's hers / his / theirs' savol-javoblarini, 'mine / ours' li gaplarni va xarakter sifati ta'riflarini (talks all day → talkative) to'g'ri ulash.
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi savol yoki gapga qaysi toshning chap tomoni mos kelishini toping.
Tekshirish belgisi: egalik olmoshi egasiga mosmi (Madina's → hers, Jasur's → his, Ali and Vali's → theirs) va birlik / ko'plik to'g'rimi (keys → They're mine).
Xarakter gaplarida ta'rifga mos sifatni toping: 'talks all day' → talkative, 'wants to know everything' → curious.
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; zanjir FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi; ustoz kalit bo'yicha tekshiradi. Xatosiz tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.

rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida sifatni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va kartadagi 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Misol bilan, egalik so'zi ishlatib tushuntirish tavsiya etiladi: 'My grandfather lives far from his children. Nobody talks to him.' (lonely).
Jamoa topsa +1 ball va keyingi karta. Taqiqlangan yoki o'zbekcha so'z aytilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi.

22.title: Find someone who… has a talkative grandmother
22.stage: Sinf mashqi 5 ('Whose is it?') dan keyin, dars o'rtasida harakatli mashq (10 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi.
22.goal: 'Is your … + sifat?' va 'Is your … similar to mine?' savollarini tuzish; to'liq javob: 'Yes, my grandmother is talkative.' / 'No, mine is quiet.'
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turib sinf bo'ylab yuradi.
O'quvchi har qator uchun savolni o'zi tuzadi: '…has a talkative grandmother' → 'Is your grandmother talkative?'; his/her → your.
Javob beruvchi egalik so'zi bilan to'liq javob beradi: 'Yes, my grandmother is very talkative.' yoki 'No, mine is quiet.'
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi. Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va natijani his / her bilan aytadi: 'Aziz's grandfather is wise. His cousins are sporty.'

23.title: Grammar Auction: this / these, a lot of / a lot
23.stage: Yangi mavzu (this/that/these/those) tushuntirilgandan keyin, lug'at bosqichidan oldin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi.
23.goal: this/that + birlik, these/those + ko'plik hamda a lot of + ot / fe'l + a lot to'g'ri ishlatilgan gaplarni xato gaplardan ajratish va xatoni tuzatish.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000. Jamoa nomini yozdiring.
Ustoz gapni doskaga yozadi yoki o'qiydi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: ot birlikmi yoki ko'plikmi (this yoki these?), 'a lot' dan keyin ot bormi (of kerakmi?).
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi va pulini varaqdan ayiradi.
Ustoz javobni aytadi: gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa (masalan: 'This is my keys.' → 'These are my keys.') +50 oladi.
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib; teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa.

27.title: Grammar Auction: will be + -ing
27.stage: Yangi mavzu tushuntirilgandan keyin, 3 davomiy zamon jadvalidan oldin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — keyingi darsga.
27.goal: Future continuous (will be + V-ing) gaplarini to'g'ri va xatoga ajratish: 'be' yoki '-ing' tushib qolishi, 'will be not', savolda 'be' o'rni, 'tomorrow' bilan were — xatolarni tuzatish.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni doskaga yozadi yoki o'qiydi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi yoki xato? Formulani eslatib qo'ying: ega + will be + V-ing.
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikkan puli yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: 'will sleeping' → 'will be sleeping').
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

G'olib natijani 'Aziz will be sleeping at 7 tomorrow morning.' shaklida sinfga aytib beradi.

28.title: Board Game: 27 topics marathon
28.stage: Sinf mashqi 1 'Zamonlar marafoni' o'rniga yoki undan keyin (20 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — exit testgacha takrorga.
28.goal: Kursdagi 27 mavzuni og'zaki takrorlash: to be, a/an, present/past simple va continuous, going to, will be + V-ing, modallar, there is/are, olmoshlar, if, would like; 3 shakl (tasdiq / inkor / savol).
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
O'yinchi zar tashlaydi va tushgan katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: to'liq gapni ovoz chiqarib aytadi.
Javoblar varag'i guruhdagi bitta 'hakam'da turadi; u tekshiradi. Xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
'Say 3 forms' katagida uchala shakl (+ / – / ?) aytilmasa, topshiriq bajarilmagan hisoblanadi.
Pushti kataklardagi buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Qiyin bo'lgan kataklarni ustoz '?' mavzular bosqichida qayta tushuntiradi.

squares.t: Say it with 'to be': my father / a driver
a or an? ___ actress, ___ painter, ___ interpreter
squares.a: an actress, a painter, an interpreter

squares.t: Make it negative: She works in a bank.
squares.a: She doesn't work in a bank.

squares.t: Make a question: He is a barber.
Say the past: go, see, make, write
Correct: I am work in a shop.
Say what is happening now: the florist / sell flowers
Make a question: They went to the sea.
squares.a: Did they go to the sea?

squares.t: Correct: He must to go now.
is or are? There ___ three pupils in the room.
squares.a: There are three pupils in the room.

squares.t: Say your plan for next summer with 'going to'.
squares.a: e.g. I am going to visit my grandparents.

squares.t: Correct: I have 15 years.
Join with 'when' (past): I / walk / see the poet
squares.a: I was walking when I saw the poet.

squares.t: Finish: If it rains tomorrow, …
Use object pronouns: I know (she). Call (we)!
Finish: This is my book. → This book is …
Which job would you like to have? Why?
squares.a: e.g. I would like to be a pianist because I love music.

squares.t: Correct: Did you went to the bookstore?
squares.a: Did you go to the bookstore?

squares.t: Adverb: He is a slow worker. → He works …
Make a sentence: this time tomorrow / the fisherman / fish
squares.a: This time tomorrow the fisherman will be fishing.

squares.t: Correct: I yesterday met a famous poet.
squares.a: I met a famous poet yesterday. (or: Yesterday I met a famous poet.)

squares.t: Say 3 forms (+ / – / ?): She can swim.
squares.a: She can swim. She can't swim. Can she swim?

squares.t: Talk for 20 seconds about a job in your family.
squares.a: e.g. My aunt is a tailor. She makes dresses. She works at home.

squares.t: Say 3 forms (+ / – / ?): They were at the railway station.
squares.a: They were… / They weren't… / Were they at the railway station?

28.title: Dominoes: questions and short answers
28.stage: Blits takror bosqichida: savol shakllarini mustahkamlash (12 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — exit testgacha takrorga.
28.goal: Turli zamon va mavzulardagi savolga mos qisqa javobni topish: Is…? — Yes, she is. / Does…? — Yes, he does. / Did…? — No, I didn't. / Can, Will, Would, May, Were…
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi savolga mos javobni boshqa toshlarning chap tomonidan toping va ulang.
Asosiy qoida: savol qaysi yordamchi so'z bilan boshlansa, qisqa javob ham shu so'z bilan (Does → does, Were → were, May → may). Egaga ham qarang (your aunt → she).
Zanjir FINISH bilan tugashi kerak. Birinchi tugatgan guruh savol-javoblarni rollarda ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi.
Ustoz tekshiradi: bitta ham xato ulangan bo'lsa — navbat keyingi guruhga o'tadi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.

pairs: Yes, she is. She makes beautiful dresses.
Does your uncle work at a bank?
Yes, he does. He's a bank clerk.
Did you see the poet at the bookstore?
No, I didn't. I was at school.
Can your brother play the guitar?
Yes, he can. He's a guitarist in a band.
Are there any grocery stores near here?
Yes, there are. There are two on this street.
Were the miners tired after work?
Yes, they were. They worked for 10 hours.
Will you be working at 9 tomorrow?
No, I won't. It's my day off.
Would you like to be an archaeologist?
Yes, I would. I love history.
May I use your phone, please?
Yes, you may. Here you are.
Are you going to travel this summer?
Yes, I am. We're going to Turkey.
Do the pupils like their new teacher?
Yes, they do. She's very kind.
Yes, she was. She smiled all the time.
Where does the fisherman sell his fish?
At the market near the river.
A great Uzbek poet. He lived over 500 years ago.

28.title: Taboo: jobs and places (revision)
28.stage: Lug'at — Revision (kasblar va joylar) bosqichidan keyin (10 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — exit testgacha takrorga.
28.goal: Kasb va joy nomlarini (florist, barber, tailor, miner, interpreter, bookstore, railway station…) inglizcha tushuntirish; present simple 3-shaxs bilan ta'rif berish (He/She works… / sells…).
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi (jamoasiga ko'rsatmaydi).
60 soniyada so'zni inglizcha tushuntiradi: kartadagi so'z va 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Maslahat: 'This person works in/at…', 'He/She usually…', 'You can buy… there' kabi gaplardan foydalaning (3-shaxs -s ni unutmang!).
Jamoa topsa +1 ball. Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa yoki o'zbekcha gapirilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi.
Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

28.title: Find someone who… (all tenses revision)
28.stage: Speaking — chek bosqichidan oldin, harakatli mashq (10 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — exit testgacha takrorga.
28.goal: Har xil zamon va mavzuda savol tuzish: Do/Does…?, Did…?, Were…?, Can…?, Are you going to…?, Will you be…?, Would you like…? va qisqa javob berish.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchi har qator uchun savolni o'zi tuzadi. Avval qatordagi fe'lga qarab zamonni aniqlaydi (went → Did…?, was → Were…?, is going to → Are you going to…?).
Javob qisqa shaklda: Yes, I do. / No, I didn't. / Yes, I was… 'Yes' degan o'quvchining ismi yoziladi ('doesn't' qatorida — 'No' degan).
Ism yozilgach, bitta qo'shimcha Wh-savol beriladi (Where? When? Why?).
Bitta ism ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin. 8 qatorni birinchi to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi.
G'olib natijalarni 3-shaxsda aytib beradi: 'Lola went to the sea last summer.' Ustoz zamon xatolarini tuzatadi.

items.q: Would you like to be an interpreter?
Do you know a good barber or hairdresser?
Did you go to the sea last summer?

items.t: …can play the piano or the guitar.
items.q: Can you play the piano or the guitar?

items.t: …is going to visit a bookstore this week.
items.q: Are you going to visit a bookstore this week?
Were you sleeping at 11 pm last night?
Will you be studying at 7 pm tomorrow?

items.t: …often goes to the grocery store with his/her mum.
items.q: Do you often go to the grocery store with your mum?
Do you like getting up early? (No, I don't.)

items.t: …was at the railway station last month.
items.q: Were you at the railway station last month?
Do you have a relative in another city?
Are you wearing something blue today?

28.title: Speaking cards: exit test check
28.stage: Speaking — chek bosqichida (10 daqiqa): har javob 1–1.5 daqiqa. Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — exit testgacha takrorga.
28.goal: Exit test speaking qismiga tayyorgarlik: har kartada boshqa zamon (present, past, going to, will be + V-ing, can/must, if, would like); kasb va joylar mavzusida 3–5 gapli javob.
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Birinchi o'quvchi karta oladi va savolni sherigiga o'qiydi.
Sherigi 1–1.5 daqiqa javob beradi (kamida 3 gap); savoldagi zamonni saqlash shart (What did…? → past simple).
Tinglovchi CHECK-LIST bilan tekshiradi: zamon to'g'ri — +1, 3-shaxs -s / did + V1 to'g'ri — +1, yangi kasb yoki joy so'zi — +1.
Rollar almashadi. Oxirida eng ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib; ustoz xato ko'p bo'lgan mavzularni '?' bosqichi uchun yozib oladi.

cards: What does your father or mother do? Where does he/she work?
What job would you like to do in the future? Why?
What did you do last weekend? Say 3 things.
What were you doing at 8 pm yesterday?
What are you going to do after the EXIT TEST?
What will you be doing this time tomorrow?
Is there a bookstore or a grocery store near your house? What can you buy there?
Would you like to be a poet or an inventor? Why?
If you have free time tomorrow, what will you do?
What can you do well? What can't you do?
What must pupils do at school? What mustn't they do?
Who is your favourite poet or writer? What do you know about him or her?
Describe your favourite place in your city. What is there?
Do you usually help at home? What do you do and how often?
What did you want to be when you were a child?

28.title: Sentence Race: 27 topics word order
28.stage: '?' mavzular bosqichida yoki uyga vazifadan oldin tezkor takror (8 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — exit testgacha takrorga.
28.goal: Turli mavzulardagi gaplarda so'z tartibi: present simple, did-savol, doesn't want to, there are, past continuous + when, if-gap, would like, can't + adverb, will be + V-ing, going to.
rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning aralashtirilgan so'zlari) bering.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi. Katta harf bilan boshlangan so'z — gap boshi, nuqta yoki so'roq belgisi yopishgan so'z — gap oxiri.
Tayyor bo'lgan jamoa qo'l ko'taradi; ustoz tekshiradi. To'g'ri bo'lsa +1 ball va keyingi konvert.
Qo'shimcha +1: jamoa gap qaysi mavzu ekanini aytsa (masalan: 'past continuous + when').
Konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

sentences: My aunt works as a tailor in Samarkand.
Did you buy fish from the fisherman?
She doesn't want to be a model.
There are two barbers in our street.
The janitor was cleaning the floor when I arrived.
If it rains, we will stay at home.
Would you like to be an interpreter?
My brother can't play the piano very well.
Will you be working at the bank tomorrow?
Is your father going to buy a new truck?

28.title: Quiz Board: EXIT TEST warm-up
28.stage: Exit test tartibi tushuntirilishidan oldin yoki test kuni boshida (15 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — exit testgacha takrorga.
28.goal: Exit testga tayyorgarlik: 3 shakl (tasdiq / inkor / savol), kursdagi tipik xatolarni tuzatish, kasb va joy so'zlari, og'zaki javob.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing: 4 ustun (bo'limlar), har birida 100–500 ball.
Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: '3 forms 400').
Ustoz savolni o'qiydi; jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi. To'g'ri — ball jamoaga.
Xato bo'lsa — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin; to'g'ri javob bergan jamoa ballni oladi.
Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib. Ko'p xato bo'lgan savollar mavzusini ustoz uyga vazifa sifatida belgilaydi.

qs.q: Make it negative: She is a nurse.
qs.a: She isn't a nurse. / She's not a nurse.

qs.q: Make a question: He works in a bank.
qs.a: Does he work in a bank?

qs.q: Past simple of: buy, teach, write
Make it negative: They went to the sea.
qs.a: They didn't go to the sea.

I have 20 years.

qs.a: She goes to school every day.

qs.q: Did you went home?

If it will rain, I will stay at home.
qs.a: If it rains, I will stay at home.

qs.q: This person cuts men's hair.
This person writes poems.
This person works under the ground.
You buy bread, milk and eggs in this shop.
This person translates what people say, not what they write.
Say your dream job with 'would like'.
qs.a: e.g. I would like to be a pianist.

qs.q: Say 3 forms (+ / – / ?): I can drive.
qs.a: I can drive. I can't drive. Can you drive?

qs.q: What were you doing at 9 last night?
qs.a: e.g. I was doing my homework.

qs.q: Finish: If I pass the EXIT TEST, …
Talk about a family member's job in 3 tenses (now, past, future).
qs.a: e.g. My aunt is a tailor. She made my dress. She will make my coat.
